locator.span: Be aware that an acute cough : is usually self-limiting and gets better within 3 to 4 weeks without antibiotics is most commonly caused by a viral upper respiratory tract infection, such as a cold or flu can also be caused by acute bronchitis , a lower respiratory tract infection, which is usually a viral infection but can be bacterial can also have other infective or non-infective causes.
